Module com.app.studysnap
Package com.app.studysnap.model

Class SqliteUserDAO

java.lang.Object
com.app.studysnap.model.SqliteUserDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
IUserDAO
public class SqliteUserDAO extends Object implements IUserDAO
SQLite implementation of IUserDAO.

Manages the Users table and provides lookups by id, username, email, and Google sub.
